title: FlipCTL Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for plugin manifest.toml, validated against its parsed TOML->JSON representation (a TOML table maps 1:1 onto a JSON object). See backend.md §4.1-§4.4. Draft/PoC stage — breaking changes expected before 1.0.

id.description: Unique plugin identifier. Used verbatim in URL paths: /api/plugins/{id}/{action}, /api/plugins/{id}/status.

version.description: Semver of the plugin itself, independent of the manifest schema version.

icon.description: Semantic icon id. Web resolves it to a bit-packed sprite, TUI to a text glyph (frontend.md §7).

category.description: Free-form grouping key for menus, e.g. 'network', 'diagnostics', 'system'.

tier.description: Trust/ownership metadata (backend.md §2.4, §4.2). Does NOT affect execution today — see backend.md §12 privilege risk.

ui_kind.description: Whether the frontend renders a hand-written screen (custom) or the shared GenericActionScreen/generic_action.rs (generic). Projected verbatim as `kind` in GET /api/registry (frontend.md §4.2).

entrypoint.description: Path to the executable, relative to the plugin directory (backend.md §8).

declared.description: Declared but NOT enforced yet (backend.md §12). Free-form capability strings, e.g. 'network.raw_socket'.

inputs.description: Parameters the user configures before/while running the plugin (backend.md §4.1).

actions.description: Soft-button bindings (backend.md §4.4). May be empty for daemon-only plugins with no user-triggerable actions.

outputs.description: Structured fields the plugin process may emit via `output` IPC messages (see ipc-messages.schema.json).

default.description: Type must match `type`: string for text/select, number for number.

options.description: Required when type=select. Static list for PoC; dynamic options (fetched from another endpoint) are a documented future extension (backend.md §4.1), not yet specified.

id.description: Matches the `fields` key a plugin uses in `output` IPC messages.

bind.description: slot:0..4 = position in the 5-slot soft-button bar (fake-flipctl2 button bar). input:<name> = a universal InputAction from the frontend.md §4.1 protocol (e.g. input:ptt). If omitted on an action, the frontend auto-assigns the next free slot in declaration order (backend.md §4.4).

name.description: Required when effect=send_event. Delivered to the running job's stdin as {"type":"event","name":<name>} (backend.md §5).

on_release.description: Optional. If absent, releasing the button/key is a no-op (ordinary tap semantics).
